title: Role-based Expert
content: You are an expert in {field} with {years} years of experience. When I ask questions about {field}, provide detailed, accurate answers with practical examples. If you're unsure about something, say so rather than guessing.
description: Assign a specific expert role to the AI for domain-specific responses.

title: Step-by-Step Reasoning
content:
Think through this problem step by step. For each step:
1. State what you're doing and why
2. Show your work
3. Verify the result before moving on

Problem: {problem}
description: Force the AI to show its reasoning process for complex problems.

title: Code Reviewer
content:
Review the following code for:
1. Correctness and logic errors
2. Performance issues
3. Security vulnerabilities
4. Code style and best practices
5. Readability and maintainability

For each issue found, explain the problem and suggest a fix.

Language: {language}
Code:
```{language}
{code}
```
description: Structured code review covering correctness, performance, security, and style.

title: Teaching Explanation
content:
Explain {concept} to a {level} student. Use:
- Simple language appropriate for their level
- Real-world analogies they can relate to
- A concrete example to illustrate the concept
- A quick quiz question at the end to test understanding

Avoid jargon unless you define it first.
description: Adapt explanations to student level with analogies and examples.

title: Comparative Analysis
description: Structured comparison of two options across multiple dimensions.

title: Writing Improver
content:
Improve the following text while maintaining its original meaning and tone. Focus on:
- Clarity and conciseness
- Grammar and punctuation
- Stronger word choices
- Better sentence flow

Original text:
{text}

Provide the improved version, then briefly list the key changes you made.
description: Improve text quality while preserving meaning and tone.

title: Structured Prompt Generator
content:
I need a prompt for: {task_description}

Create a well-structured prompt that includes:
1. A clear role definition
2. Specific instructions
3. Input/output format expectations
4. Constraints and guidelines
5. Examples if helpful

The prompt should be reusable and produce consistent results.
description: Generate well-structured prompts for any task description.

title: Lesson Plan Generator
content:
Create a detailed lesson plan for teaching {topic} to {audience}.

Include:
1. Learning objectives (3-5 measurable goals)
2. Prerequisites students should have
3. Introduction/hook activity (5 min)
4. Main content breakdown with timing
5. Hands-on activity or exercise
6. Assessment questions
7. Homework/further reading suggestions

Total duration: {duration}
Teaching style: {style}
description: Generate complete lesson plans with objectives, activities, and assessments.

title: Debug Helper
description: Structured debugging assistance with error analysis and prevention tips.

title: Content Summarizer
description: Summarize content with configurable format, length, and audience.
